info.name: Milestone 3 - Equipment Inventory API
info.description:
Equipment Inventory Manager REST API

This API manages equipment records using Express, TypeScript, and MySQL.

Base URL: [http://localhost:5000](http://localhost:5000)  
Resource path: /api/equipment-items  
Authentication: None required.

Operations:  
GET /api/equipment-items — List all equipment.  
GET /api/equipment-items/:id — Retrieve one equipment record.  
POST /api/equipment-items — Create an equipment record.  
PUT /api/equipment-items/:id — Update all editable fields.  
DELETE /api/equipment-items/:id — Delete an equipment record.

POST and PUT require Content-Type: application/json.

Editable fields: name, description, quantity, isAvailable.  
The database generates equipmentId.

Errors use a JSON error object containing code and message.  
Field validation errors also include fields.

request.description:
Retrieves all equipment records, ordered by equipmentId.

Method: GET  
URL: [http://localhost:5000/api/equipment-items](http://localhost:5000/api/equipment-items)

Request body: None.  
Authentication: None.

200 OK: Returns a JSON array of equipment records.  
An empty inventory returns \[\].

Each record contains:  
equipmentId — Database-generated integer.  
name — Equipment name.  
description — Description string or null.  
quantity — Nonnegative integer.  
isAvailable — Boolean indicating usability.

500 Internal Server Error: An unexpected database or server failure.

Creates an equipment record with a database-generated ID.

Method: POST  
URL: [http://localhost:5000/api/equipment-items](http://localhost:5000/api/equipment-items)  
Content-Type: application/json  
Authentication: None.

Required JSON fields:  
name — String; trimmed length of 1–100 characters.  
description — String of up to 2000 characters, or null.  
quantity — Integer between 0 and 2147483647.  
isAvailable — Boolean: true or false.

All four fields must be supplied. Unknown fields are rejected.  
Do not include equipmentId.  
Blank descriptions are normalized to null.  
Availability indicates usability independently of quantity.

Example request:  
{  
"name": "Cordless Drill",  
"description": "18-volt cordless drill with battery and charger.",  
"quantity": 5,  
"isAvailable": true  
}

201 Created: Returns the saved equipment object, including equipmentId.  
The Location header identifies the new resource path.

400 Bad Request: Invalid JSON, unknown fields, or invalid field values.  
415 Unsupported Media Type: Content-Type is not application/json.  
500 Internal Server Error: An unexpected database or server failure.

Retrieves one equipment record by its database-generated ID.

Method: GET  
URL: [http://localhost:5000/api/equipment-items/:id](http://localhost:5000/api/equipment-items/:id)

Replace :id with an existing equipment ID, such as 2.  
The ID must be an integer between 1 and 2147483647.

Request body: None.  
Authentication: None.

200 OK: Returns the equipment object containing equipmentId,  
name, description, quantity, and isAvailable.

400 Bad Request: The ID is invalid.  
404 Not Found: No equipment exists with that ID.  
500 Internal Server Error: An unexpected database or server failure.

Example error:  
{  
"error": {  
"code": "NOT_FOUND",  
"message": "Equipment not found."  
}  
}

Updates all editable fields of an existing equipment record.

Method: PUT  
URL: [http://localhost:5000/api/equipment-items/:id](http://localhost:5000/api/equipment-items/:id)  
Content-Type: application/json  
Authentication: None.

Replace :id with an existing equipment ID, such as 2.  
The ID must be an integer between 1 and 2147483647.

All four editable fields are required:  
name — String; trimmed length of 1–100 characters.  
description — String of up to 2000 characters, or null.  
quantity — Integer between 0 and 2147483647.  
isAvailable — Boolean: true or false.

Unknown fields are rejected. Do not include equipmentId.  
Blank descriptions are normalized to null.  
Availability indicates usability independently of quantity.

Example request:  
{  
"name": "Cordless Drill",  
"description": "18-volt cordless drill currently under maintenance.",  
"quantity": 3,  
"isAvailable": false  
}

200 OK: Returns the updated equipment object.  
Submitting unchanged values also returns 200.  
The ID remains unchanged. A missing record is not created.

400 Bad Request: Invalid ID, malformed JSON, or invalid input.  
404 Not Found: No equipment exists with that ID.  
415 Unsupported Media Type: Content-Type is not application/json.  
500 Internal Server Error: An unexpected database or server failure.

Permanently deletes one equipment record.

Method: DELETE  
URL: [http://localhost:5000/api/equipment-items/:id](http://localhost:5000/api/equipment-items/:id)  
Authentication: None.

Replace :id with an existing equipment ID, such as 2.  
The ID must be an integer between 1 and 2147483647.

Request body: None.

204 No Content: The record was deleted. No response body is returned.

400 Bad Request: The ID is invalid.  
404 Not Found: No equipment exists with that ID.  
500 Internal Server Error: An unexpected database or server failure.

Repeating DELETE for a deleted record returns 404.  
Use GET afterward to verify that the record is absent.
